description: Standard aesthetic and VHS presets catalog for Mistus AV Merger

presets.name: Clean VHS (SP Mode)
presets.description: Subtle 90s tape softness, mild luma noise, calibrated vintage gamma.

presets.name: Worn Tape (LP Mode)
presets.description: Noticeable magnetic tape wear, horizontal jitter, slight chromashift.

presets.name: Tracking Errors
presets.description: Bottom head-switching noise band, horizontal tear glitches, phase misregistration.

presets.name: Chroma Bleed
presets.description: Color misregistration, heavy red/cyan bleed characteristic of composite RCA cables.

presets.name: Camcorder 90s
presets.description: High saturation, warm white-balance, sharp interlace lines, nostalgic home-video feel.

presets.name: Security Cam (CCTV)
presets.description: Monochrome high-contrast surveillance look with scanline interference.

presets.name: Heavy Degradation
presets.description: Severe analog generation loss, static snow bursts, tracking tears, magnetic decay.
